Isitolo sezithelo sithengisa ama-apula emabhokisini. Ibhokisi ngalinye liphethe inani elifanayo lama-apula. UMinsu uhlele inani lamabhokisi nenani lama-apula ethebuleni.
Lapho inani lamabhokisi lingu-1, kunama-apula angu-5; lapho inani lamabhokisi lingu-2, kunama-apula angu-10; lapho inani lamabhokisi lingu-3, kunama-apula angu-15.
UMinsu uthe, “Uma wengeza u-4 enanini lamabhokisi, uthola inani lama-apula.”
